target: AArch64 native ZealC in PCI QEMU guest
changes: Added an ARM64 IsDir bridge over source-tree and explicitly mounted read-only RedSea directories.
Added a regression for source roots, ordinary directories, empty RedSea directories, drive aliases, trailing slashes, file paths and missing paths.

redsea_isdir_probe.command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-stock-redsea-file
redsea_isdir_probe.result: pass: RedSea file and IsDir cases passed, source-store compaction completed, empty-file persistence and deleted-path behavior survived cold reboot, and final zstatus reported failed=0

redsea_isdir_probe.note: The current run used the system QEMU PCI guest. The single-pass latest-record catalog optimization allowed full compaction to complete.
